From wave 2 onward, at least 1 appears per wave. The base expected count is the larger of 1 and wave/8, multiplied by the difficulty factor, increased by up to 100% through Corruption, and capped at 9 per wave. The count is rolled at wave start; spawns occur in the first half. Corruption also increases its HP, damage, and armor. When the player is within 240 range and its cooldown is ready, it charges for 1 second, then dashes and swings over 0.16 seconds. Its rectangular warning has no arrow, 12% interior opacity, red edges, and pulsing square particles.
